The insurance industry makes a huge amount of money from the current US system and the hospitals, doctors etc also make a huge amount of money. It makes sense that the insurance companies don't mind the high costs because the hospitals are in on the game and this is their part of this lucrative pie. People need to be treated early rather than far too late (a result of putting off treatment until the last possible minute due to the costs.)
